_description: Task13 WEIGHTING field (unit probe), COARSE transcription -- the 0.22mm far-field grid for the 5x5 LArPix v2a tile at the true 4.4mm pitch. The fine sibling (example_gen_pixel_with_grid_task13_fine.json) carries the true design values unsnapped. SNAPPED PAD/GAP, AND WHY ONLY HERE: the design values are pixelSize 3.5, pixelGap 0.9, chamfer_r 0.7. gcd(35,9) = 1, so NO spacing coarser than 0.1mm divides both the pad and the gap exactly and some snapping on the coarse grid is unavoidable. 0.22mm was chosen because it snaps the pad to 3.52mm, only +1.1% in area, against +5.8% for 0.2 or 0.4. That error matters more than it looks: the far field in the final stitched output IS the upsampled coarse solution, so a coarse pad-area error biases the far weighting field by about the same percentage, and it is a SMOOTH error that the Laplacian residual metric cannot detect. The design values are preserved as the _design_* keys below; the generators ignore _design_* keys. CELL COUNTS AT 0.22mm: pixelSize 3.52 -> 16 cells, pixelGap 0.88 -> 4 cells, chamfer_r 0.66 -> 3 cells (0.7/0.22 = 3.18). PITCH MUST STAY EXACTLY 4.4mm = 20 coarse cells: 16 + 4 = 20. hybrid_iterate.py _cells() requires the transverse extent to be a WHOLE number of cells and raises otherwise, so this is a hard constraint, not a preference; the two coarse files must also stay consistent with each other, since the drift tile and the weighting probe have to model the SAME pad. NO GridPotential and NO CathodePotential, deliberately: the weighting potential is a dimensionless unit probe in [0,1], not volts -- collecting pixel = 1 and every other electrode including the cathode = 0 -- so the cathode formula in the drift configs (example_gen_pcb_drift_pixel_task13_*.json) does not apply here. DEPTH: driftZDepth 79.15 with pixelPlaneLowEdgePosition 10.0 tracks the drift pair's 69.15mm geometry; the weighting solve itself does not use a drift length, but the number is kept in step so the file handed to induce-pixel is not stale. It is deliberately NOT rounded to 79.2: the domain closes at ceil(79.15/0.22) = 360 coarse cells = 79.2mm, the last plane of the 361-node coarse z grid, so there is no dead space above the cathode, while the launch node 79.15 does not land on that grounded plane. gen_pcb_pixel_with_grid.py grounds its cathode at int(round(driftZDepth/spacing)) = 360, the same plane. PROBE: Npixels 5 at the 4.4mm pitch = 22.0mm transverse, i.e. 100 cells at this file's 0.22mm spacing, solved NON-periodic (edges fix,fix,fix) so phi_w decays to ~0 at the tile edges instead of wrapping; a weighting field cannot be solved on the single periodic pixel tile the drift field uses.
